instructions: Comment inline only on must-fix findings: wrong or broken behaviour; an error swallowed or reported as success; data loss (a write that can drop text another writer added, or a move or delete with no kept copy); a security problem or a leaked token, session id or home folder path; a requirement of the linked issue, or a rule in AGENTS.md, CONTRIBUTING.md or docs/dev/team-process.md, that the change does not meet; a bug fix or behaviour change with no test. A must-fix needs one event: one outside fault (a failed write, a crash, a lost connection) or one ordering of steps. A message lost, sent twice, or started in a turn that is already running, and a security problem, are must-fix however many events lead there. Any other case that needs two events at once (a failed write during a restart) is not must-fix: list it at the end of the summary as 'Edge: file:line, both events, the wrong result', never inline, so it gets an issue of its own. A problem already on main in code this pull request does not change goes in the summary as 'Pre-existing', not inline. A linked issue's requirements count for an issue the body says it fixes (Fixes #N), and for a 'Part of #N' issue only the points that line lists. Each finding names the file and line, a concrete input or sequence that goes wrong, and the fix. Everything else (naming, style, refactors, optional tests) goes in at most three short lines at the end of the summary, never as an inline comment. Do not repeat a finding that a later commit fixed or that the PR conversation already answered.

rules.rule: Every user-visible string added or changed must have an entry in all three string tables: hooks/i18n.ts, hooks/strings-en.ts and hooks/strings-zh-cn.ts. A string only in one or two of them is a must-fix.
Tests, fixtures, docs and pictures use synthetic data only: no real person names, session ids, home folder paths (C:\Users\<name>, /Users/<name>, /home/<name>), tokens or real conversation text.

A write to the progress file or another user file must not lose text another writer added between the read and the write: read again just before writing and check the result after. Report a removed or skipped re-read as a must-fix.

hooks/board-script.ts and its parts (hooks/board-script-1.ts, -2.ts, ...) are built by scripts/build-board.ts, and hooks/released.ts (with tests/fixtures/released.ts) by scripts/build-released.ts, both with Bun 1.4.2. Never ask for a hand edit there; when a source file they are built from changes, the PR rebuilds them or its body says 'maintainer rebuilds at merge'.
